metadata.name: skin shuffle
metadata.description:
[h1]Skin Shuffle[/h1] [h2]What It Does[/h2] Randomly shuffles the sprite positions of room entities, creating visual chaos. Each entity's sprite is rendered at another entity's location.
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*]Random derangement mapping - no entity maps to itself [*]Chain propagation when entities die [*]Configurable via Mod Config Menu - choose which entity types participate [/list]
[h2]Entity Type Options[/h2] [list] [*]Normal Monsters [*]Bosses [*]Pickups [*]Friendly Monsters [*]Invulnerable Traps [/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681872191]Mod Config Menu Pure[/url] is recommended for in-game settings.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812798412]Binding of Chaos[/url] is also recommended to play with.
[h3]Bug Reports & Feedback[/h3] If you run into any bugs, feel free to leave a comment below, or submit an issue on my [url=https://github.com/changchanggod/MyIsaacMods]GitHub repository[/url]. All feedback is appreciated.
